name: bond-monorepo
description: Bond CMS — root scripts boot mock-server + frontend song song.

scripts.dev:mockup: concurrently -k -n mock,fe -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix mock-server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:api: concurrently -k -n api,fe-api -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix api-server" "npm run dev:api --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n mock,api,fe-mock,fe-api -c yellow,green,cyan,blue "npm run dev --prefix mock-server" "npm run dev --prefix api-server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:api --prefix frontend"
